messages:
Zoe: Heads-up: onboarding sample (python) shows null/missing request IDs in structured logs when OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=1 and LOG_LEVEL=debug. Repro on linux VM.
Marco: Seen it in CI too. Structured JSON logs have "req_id": null for retried requests. Non-auto-instrumented runs keep the id.
Leila: Which python sdk + autoinstrument versions? I thought we handled header preservation in the last patch.
Zoe: python-sdk v0.7.2, opentelemetry-auto 1.8. Sampleapp uses uvicorn + fastapi. Bisection points to the auto-instrumentation wrapper around httpx which re-creates headers on retry.
Marco: Minimal repro (order matters):
```py
# app.py
from redwood_telemetry import otel_hook, log_hook
app.add_middleware(otel_hook)
app.add_middleware(log_hook)
# httpx client uses auto-instrumented transport
```
Marco: When auth-refresh middleware triggers a 401->refresh->replay path, the auto-instrumented client rebuilds the request and the x-request-id header sometimes gets dropped. With REDACT_SENSITIVE=true it goes a step further and the header key is removed from the header dict instead of masked.
Leila: Sounds like two issues: (1) auto-instrumentation rebuilds headers on replay and doesn't copy custom headers, (2) our redaction hook mutates headers destructively during retry.
Dan: Quick workaround: set OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=0 for onboarding sample or configure opentelemetry to preserve custom headers (if supported). Also we can update log_hook to fall back to request scope: `request.state.headers.get('x-request-id')` before giving up.
Zoe: Repro steps I used: clone python-sample, `export LOG_LEVEL=debug OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=1 REDACT_SENSITIVE=true && uvicorn app:app --reload`, then run `for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do http POST http://localhost:8000/api/text q=x; done` and inspect logs (json lines).
Marco: Short-term PR idea: 1) make redaction non-destructive (mask only), 2) log_hook fallback to original scope header, 3) doc note to disable auto-instrument for sampleapps until we ship fix.
Leila: Prefer non-destructive redaction first, that's low risk. For auto-instrumentation we should file an upstream issue and add a test harness that simulates a replayed request keeping headers.
Zoe: Filed TW-5821 and linked a small repro gist: https://gist.github.com/zoe/12ab34cd. Pushed PR draft with redaction fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/84 (WIP).
telemetry-bot: New issue created: TW-5821 - "python sdk: x-request-id lost with OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT + retries" - linked to PR #84.
onboarding-bot: Heads-up: hold hosted python sample deployment until TW-5821 resolved to avoid first-run confusion.
Dan: I'll add a feature flag and a unit test that asserts header preserved across retry replay. If CI green we'll merge redaction fix behind flag.
Zoe: Thanks team. I'll attach the failing CI log and exact environment to TW-5821. :coffee:
